system.description: Inbreeding is a common occurrence among the incestuous Giovanni clan, and this Flaw's specifics should be worked out with the Storyteller. At one Trait, you suffer a one-Trait resolution penalty on Social Challenges due to an unwholesome or flawed appearance (eyes too close together, an underbite, etc.). At three Traits, you suffer that penalty plus a one-Trait resolution penalty on Physical Challenges from a congenital health defect. At five Traits, you suffer both previous penalties plus an effect equivalent to one other Flaw chosen by the Storyteller (such as being Lame or having an extra Derangement).
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
